summary: Visible change: the placeholder of the pill composer (RichMentionInput in mention mode, the default composer with chatInteractions or completionProviders) now stays visible while the empty editor has focus, like a native placeholder. It used to disappear on focus.
howTo: Nothing to do for the new default. To keep the earlier look, set composer={{ placeholderOnFocus: false }} on AiChatProvider, VercelAiChat or <glirastes-chat> (config.composer); it reaches the built-in composer and useChatComposerInput().inputProps. An own RichMentionInput takes the prop placeholderOnFocus={false}. The placeholder still hides as soon as text or a pill is in the editor. CSS on [data-element="placeholder"] keeps working; a rule that assumed the placeholder is never shown on :focus-within may need a look. The plain text field (no completion) uses the browser placeholder and is unchanged. Tests that expected no [data-element="placeholder"] after focusing the editor now find it.
